paragraphs.source_en: By virtue of the consistency of the dictionary developed by Witten and oth ers, we have strong evidence that all five string theories are different descriptions of a single master theory, M-theory, but researchers have yet to develop a complete understanding of this theoretical nexus. We have learned much about M-theory in the last few years, but we still have far to go before anyone could sensibly claim that it is properly or completely understood. In string theory, it's as if we have five translations of a yet-to be-discovered master text.
